u0: Normal progress: there is no unresolved box fall. Continue toward the exit while keeping the box available; if the box falls, switch to immediate recovery. Step onto the exit while holding the box to succeed—reaching it without the box ends in failure.
u1: Post-fall recovery: the box has just slipped and is not currently held. On the immediate next step, pick it up again; regaining the box restores normal progress. If the next step passes without holding the box, the episode ends in terminal failure.
u2: Success terminal: the exit has been reached while carrying the box. The task is complete, and no further action or objective remains.
u3: Failure terminal: the episode has failed, either by reaching the exit without the box or by failing to pick the box up immediately after a fall. No further recovery or progress is possible.
